name: pricing-page
title: Pricing page
description: The pricing page template, built only from library items: the Creator plan ad as the top (the offer headline under the light field, the plan card) and the questions, answered with what the plan says.
use_for: A website's pricing. Each plan is a plan card; edit lib/pages/pricing.ts or pass `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
A price or a feature the plan does not state
source: Built from the library (site header, offer block, plan card, footer row); Figma page 8: Ad, Creator plan offer; the plan's copy is the ad's own

import { html } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { pricingContent, type PricingContent } from '@/lib/pages/pricing' import '@/elements/components/site/plan-card' import '@/elements/components/blocks/offer-block' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // PricingPage.tsx as : the Creator plan ad as the top and the questions. `content` replaces the copy. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' /** * @summary The pricing page template. */ export class PricingPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="pricing-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The page's copy (lib/pages/pricing.ts by default). */ content: PricingContent = pricingContent render() { const c = this.content ?? pricingContent return html`
${c.plans.map((p) => html``)}

${c.faq.title}

${c.faq.items.map((i) => html`
${i.q}
${i.a}
`)}
` } } define('pricing-page', PricingPage)
